profile.headline: Consultant Software Engineer | OS Kernel Developer | Cross-Group Leader | RAID Storage Internals Expert
profile.jobTitle: Consultant Software Engineer, Cyber System Assessments
profile.summary:
Working within the kernel of an Operating System and doing it well requires a key set of skills. It isn't enough to understand the concepts; you must understand how to use, not abuse them. My passion builds on this principal, sweating the details that will make the various sub-systems play well together. In doing this, my understanding encompasses from hardware implementations to overall system architecture to analyzing customer use cases.

To deliver above-average results, I drive technical project leadership: I own projects across the organization, building bridges between groups. I strive to ensure that all work is properly identified, that all components will work together, and that all development is coordinated to come together as expected. 

Review my profile below. You will discover a range of experiences. Earlier jobs lead to new opportunities in storage covering drives to drivers, configuration to cache and RAID, and roles ranging from individual contributor to release coordinator. My latest work at MIT Lincoln Laboratory in cybersecurity had me pivot to hypervisors and full-stack development.

The question is, what need can I fill for you?

I'm available to discuss new opportunities in the Metro-West Boston area. Please contact me at CJimCook@gmail.com.


TECHNICAL SKILLS:

Languages: C, Python, plus two-dozen assemblers and other languages
Operating Systems: Unix (Linux, Solaris, FTX), Microsoft Windows, MacOS, VrTX, et al
Processors: x86, PowerPC, 68K, i860, HPPA, etc.
Tools: git, Accurev, Clearcase, gdb, windbg, RPCGEN, Flexelint, Purify
Technologies: SCSI, FC/iSCSI, RAID, Cache, Snap-Copy, Mirroring, KVM hypervisors, Intel processor trace, Django, Angular, Authentication
Security Clearance: Secret and CBI (Commercial Background Investigation)

positions.title: Consultant Software Engineer, Cyber System Assessments
positions.description:
•	Enhanced KVM-based hypervisor framework support for Fuzzer-based testing of software binaries for verification and malware detection.

•	Added authentication support to Docker-based distributed malware analysis tool in Python using Django, and Angular frameworks.

positions.title: Principal Engineer, Drive Error Detection & Recovery | Hyperconverged Storage
positions.description:
Migrated proprietary SAS drivers to the Linux SCSI stack for a future hyperconverged product.

Selected accomplishments:
• Enhanced level 3 SAS driver, enabling RAID processing of I/O errors, increasing product reliability and reducing future service calls.

• Architected error injection into SAS and NVMe drive data paths, facilitating automated testing of critical recovery paths prior to product shipment.

positions.title: Release Stream Manager
positions.description:
Integration stream manager for 287 developer Accurev workspaces and sub-streams. Coordinated software submissions and testing through direct contact with personnel across the organization including China, India, and St. Petersburg, Russia. Recognized with EMC Gold, Silver, and Bronze management awards.

Selected accomplishments:
• Delivered 3 major Unity storage array releases;  recognized with EMC Gold, Silver, and Bronze management awards.

• Coordinated Jenkins builds, test result triage and problem dispatch to individual developers.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Cross-System Migration Team
positions.description: Provided general consulting (debug, panics, architecture, enhancements) to support transitioning product from Windows to Linux via cross-platform software development framework (CSX).  Supplied emergency internal customer support as needed on an international basis.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, Core Array Software
positions.description:
Technical leader in the Flare CM team, providing development, consulting, and support. 

Selected accomplishments:
 • Added Non-Disruptive Upgrade (NDU) support for new Multi-Core RAID (MCR) product, awarded EMC Silver management award.

 • Led Customer Crisis Team resulting in EMC Silver management award.

 • Data Mis-Compare team co-lead resulting in EMC Silver management award.

 • Architectural coordinator for Data-At-Rest Encryption and DoD-approved secure erasure.

positions.title: Principal Engineer, Entry Systems Group
positions.description:
Leadership position producing new line of low-end storage arrays.

Selected accomplishments:
 • Technical Lead of AX100 software releases 17, 18, 19.

 • Stepped in as co-program manager to successfully deliver AX100SEi prototype.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer, SCSI Host Protocol Engine
positions.description:
Co-lead of SCSI protocol engine development:

 • Created host virtualization product through enhanced LUN mapping / LUN masking.

• Prototyped iSCSI support leading to new storage array offering.

• Added SCSI NACA, volume set addressing, auto-trespass to open HP server sales market.
